comparisonProtocol.primaryUse: Contested play under honest 1-reply search: elimination%, captures, length, legitimate draws (split repetition vs move-cap), W/L and FPA when gamesWithWinner > 0
comparisonProtocol.secondaryUse: Longer-horizon attrition (2-reply) — never rank by D3 elimination% alone
comparisonProtocol.terminologyNote: Say elimination — not "decisive". move-cap is Lab harness safety only.
comparisonProtocol.honestDepthNote: D1=greedy, D2=1 opponent full-turn reply, D3=2 opponent full-turn replies.

termGlossary.elimination: One player captured all opposing beads → win.
termGlossary.stalemate: Player to move has no legal move → opponent wins.
termGlossary.moveCap: Lab-only turn limit (e.g. 120). Stops endless games for batch testing. Not a traditional rule.
termGlossary.withWinner: Game ended with a winner (elimination or stalemate). Not called "decisive".
termGlossary.elimOrStalematePct: Share of games ending by elimination or stalemate (legacy name: forcedWinPct).
